# Will the 3.8% investment surtax hit you, and what moves it?

> Free net investment income tax (NIIT) calculator: your Form 8960 lines, how far you are over the $200,000 / $250,000 threshold, what an extra gain costs and whether splitting it across two years saves tax. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
